design_conditions: Stage all public reader/parser fields until stable complete anchored tail is proven
Three bounded immediate retries; never publish cached AUTO or an empty false job change
Private provisional backlog progress revalidates identity and consumed hash before continuing
Post-parse bytes/stat/latest selection revalidation before all publication
Missing anchor/candidate, partial tail, unread backlog and exhausted retry raise typed read-unavailable
Preserve CSV cursor and trusted public state on unavailable reads
Keep existing IR hold/reset behavior for prolonged unavailability; actual new jobs block old results
Transition-only durable diagnostics preserve source and reset reasons without granting write authority
